name: Moshi Moshi Milk Cocktail Debut
original_name: もしもし みるくカクテル Debut
source:
Get acquainted with a girl by email and date her without making mistakes to get to know her for real. Make the wrong selection in-game, and you'll end up raping the girl like a dirty crook, and what will be the end of that?! A simple love, adventure game that advances with a fresh, crisp storyline!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-march-2003-interlude.html]vndbreview[/url] and [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ007782.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
通过邮件认识女孩并与她约会，不犯错才能真正了解她。游戏中做出错误选择，你就会像肮脏恶棍一样强奸女孩，结局会如何！？一款以清新明快剧情推进的简单恋爱冒险游戏！
